_comment: MCP server definitions for llama.cpp --mcp-servers-config. Connects to donsetch (HTTP MCP stdIO proxy) for web search/fetch/crawl/screenshot. SearXNG support was REMOVED in Sep 2026 — engines CAPTCHA on RU datacenter IPs and result quality was unacceptable. See docs/MIGRATION-TO-DONSETCH.md.

donsetch._comment: stdIO proxy to donsetch-http (HTTP MCP). Connects to http://localhost:8765/mcp (or DONSETCH_URL env) and re-exposes 4 tools (web_search, web_fetch, web_crawl, web_screenshot) over stdIO for llama.cpp. See docs/DONSETCH.md.
